integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically. Finite enumeration is used only as regression evidence. Sharpness uses only classical prime existence in doubling intervals and does not rely on a finite search.
scientific_limitations: The exact second-moment identity is elementary and may have equivalent appearances under generalized divisor-sum derivatives or random-divisor notation. The originality claim is limited to the explicit P3 identity together with the sharp fixed-exponent infimum and its nonattainment for multi-prime support, relative to the inspected literature.
title: Exact logarithmic divisor moment and the sharp exponent-pattern envelope
